title: mnemospark-lite paid file upload API for wallet-scoped storage. Returns a presig
description: mnemospark-lite paid file upload API for wallet-scoped storage. Returns a presigned S3 upload URL, completion token, and bearer for listing and downloading uploaded files. Files expire automatically after 30 days.

_signals.x_guidance: Use POST /api/mnemospark-lite/upload to create a paid upload slot. First, call it without payment headers to receive a 402 Payment Required challenge in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. Pay the exact accepts[0].amount from that challenge using x402, then retry POST /api/mnemospark-lite/upload with the payment payload in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or x-payment. Upload the file bytes with an HTTP PUT to the returned uploadUrl. Finally, call POST /api/mnemospark-lite/upload/complete with uploadId and completion_token to mint a share URL. Use GET /api/mnemospark-lite/uploads and GET /api/mnemospark-lite/download/{uploadId} with the returned bearer token to list and fetch download details. Use POST /api/mnemospark-lite/share to mint a 24-hour share URL and POST /api/mnemospark-lite/shares/exchange to redeem a share token for a presigned download URL.
